episodes.name: Invisible Joy Ride
episodes.overviewEn: Features the main characters deciding whether or not to take Wonder Woman's invisible jet for a joyride.

episodes.name: Time Waits For No Girl
episodes.overviewEn: Features Batgirl racing to join Wonder Girl and Supergirl in a fight against Poison Ivy.

episodes.name: Grounded
episodes.overviewEn: Features Batgirl and Wonder Girl convincing Supergirl, who is grounded to her house, to join them at crimefighting. She agrees, but Superman catches her sneaking out and tries to stop her. They fight, and eventually Ma Kent breaks up the fight and Supergirl dejectedly returns home.

episodes.name: Name Game
episodes.overviewEn: Features the main characters deciding on a name for their team while they fight Cheetah.

episodes.name: Don't Fight Girls
episodes.overviewEn: Features the main characters trying to convince Solomon Grundy to fight them.
